test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On 22 July 2020, actor Sonu Sood launched the ______ app to find jobs and offer specific job training programmes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pravasi Rojgar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pravasi Rojgar**__

 __
 
• **Sonu Sood** launched **Pravasi Rojgar app **to help migrants find job opportunities to help workers.
 
• Pravasi Rojgar App can be availed by migrant workers and skilled workers only.
 
• Through the Pravasi, the Rojgar app to seek the right employment opportunities for migrant workers in different parts of the country will be supported by community outreach in villages.
 
• It is a free online platform to provides all the necessary information and correct links to find a job.
 
 
 
• **Sonu Sood**__
 
 
• He is an Indian actor, film producer, model.
 
• He received the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor- Telugu for his work in the Telugu blockbuster Arundhati.
 
• In September 2020 he was chosen for the 'SDG Special Humanitarian Action Award by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) for his humanitarian works during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• He was announced as the Delhi Government's brand ambassador of its Desh ke Mentor programme by the Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal on 27 August 2021.
